thread:
Miriam Soto: Quick heads-up  candidate Tomas Rivera has a daycare issue and asked if we can shift his in-person loop later to 11:30 PT or compress it into a shorter window. Hed still like an on-site whiteboard if possible.
Derek Chang: I can swap my slot to later and host until 15:00 if needed. :+1: Which panels are flexible?
Ava (People Ops): I'll ping the interviewers now. We can propose 11:3020
Miriam Soto: Panels are Eng Design (was 09:45), Systems (10:30), and Lunch + Whiteboard (12:30). Could compress to two panels + whiteboard 11:3020
Ava (People Ops): Quick availability check: Sara is ok to move to 12:00, Omar cant do after 13:00, Priya can cover Systems at 11:45. Proposing: 11:30 intro (Derek), 11:45 Systems (Priya), 12:30 whiteboard + lunch. That keeps it to ~2.5h.
Derek Chang: I can do the intro in Spanish if helpful; candidate noted Spanish preference.
Miriam Soto: Excellent, candidate said bilingual would be helpful. 
IT Help: Loaner inventory quick check:
```
loaners.find(os="linux", date="2024-10-15") => [LN-99 (ThinkPad Ubuntu), LN-102 (Dell Pop_OS)]
```
IT Help: Reserving LN-99 and will image with the demo repo. Will stage in Meeting Room B by 10:45; network egress disabled.
Ava (People Ops): Tomas asked if he can run a small local server for the whiteboard demo. IT, can you pre-run the server in an offline VM?
IT Help: Yes  we'll preload a VM with the server and a README. No outbound network. If he needs git access, we can issue a temporary service account that expires after 8 hours.
Reception Bot: Note  candidate driving? He said rideshare likely. If he drives, which parking preference? Also needs accessible entrance due to a knee brace.
Miriam Soto: He'll probably rideshare but might drive. I'll ask for license plate if he decides to drive. Please mark accessible entrance and elevator escort at check-in.
Catering: Lunch note  candidate requested a nut-free, dairy-free boxed lunch and asked for a small bottled apple sauce that his toddler likes (hed like to bring it)  we can include child-friendly snack in the packet.
Ava (People Ops): Company childcare policy reminder: we provide up to $100 childcare reimbursement for interview-related needs with receipt. I'll include the claim form link in confirmation.
Miriam Soto: Also DocuSign NDA still pending from Tomas. Ava, did we resend?
Ava (People Ops): Resent NDA and added a note: please sign before arrival or bring photo ID to sign a paper copy.
Derek Chang: One interviewer swap: Omar unavailable after 13:00 so Priya confirmed Systems. I've updated the calendar and added "Meet Host: Derek Chang".
Reception Bot: Check-in script updated: "Ask for ID, flag accessible entrance, elevator escort, hold child-snack packet at reception, page Derek on arrival."
IT Help: Temporary VPN token queued if candidate needs remote access; will expire in 6 hours. Please DM candidate email to issue.
Miriam Soto: Candidate email is tomas.rivera@example.com  Ava please DM IT. Also please add a 15-min buffer after whiteboard in case childcare pickup runs long.
Ava (People Ops): On it  NDA reminder sent, childcare reimbursement link included, loaner reserved, catering asked to pack child-friendly snack, parking/access notes added, VPN queued. I'll post final checklist here once IT confirms imaging and reception confirms packet.
IT Help: LN-99 imaged and staged in Meeting Room B at 10:40. VM pre-run and README attached. Temporary git account created (expires 8h).
Reception Bot: Candidate packet printed and staged: badge template, child-snack, accessible entrance map, host contact (Derek), parking options. All set.
Miriam Soto: Perfect  I'll email Tomas with the proposed 11:30 start and confirm NDA + pickup needs. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
